abstract: A large intrapericardial teratoma was found at necropsy in a 38-week stillborn fetus, in which prenatal diagnosis of hydrops fetalis and an echogenic cardiac mass had been made. Clinical and pathological data are reported. In utero intrapericardial teratomata lead to different outcomes depending on whether fetal hydrops is associated. When generalized fetal hydrops is not present, the outcome is good, even in cases with large pericardial effusions. When generalized fetal hydrops occurs, it often results in a poor outcome. In our literature review, we have found eight perinatal deaths in nine similar cases reported.
abstract_ja: 38週で死産となった胎児の剖検で、大型の心膜内奇形腫が認められた。出生前診断では胎児水腫と心臓の高エコー性腫瘤が確認されていた。臨床および病理所見を報告し、文献的考察を加えた。子宮内で発生した心膜内奇形腫は、全身性胎児水腫を伴わない場合、心膜液貯留が大きくても予後良好となりうる。全身性胎児水腫を伴う場合は、しばしば予後不良となる。文献レビューでは、類似の9例中8例が周産期死亡であった。
